doc.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024

title: Recent European tour and family help
summary: A hard tour with the New JBs and Generations; his daughter Joya and other children help.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: That’s a great quote from you. Wonderful attitude. What’s coming up — you just got back from Europe, is that correct?

Yeah, it was a hard, hard tour. And that’s why I’m going to slow down you know? I did two weeks with my band, the New JBs and we did a lot of shows and went directly to another group that I played with, it’s called Generations. It features Leonardo Corradi on the organ, he’s a young man that plays organ like Jimmy Smith — I mean far, way, way better than Jimmy Smith. And — from Italy. And a drummer from Paris. So we did a trio thing too for two weeks. And that took a lot out of me you know, that’s why I’m coughing now. So I think I’ve got to slow down from now on you know. That showed me that I’m — it’s telling me I should act my age. Because I’m not a young man anymore, although I enjoyed doing it, but getting from place to place is getting to be a little difficult now.
Do you have family members that help you out with the logistics and all that?

Oh yeah, my daughter, my daughter Joya, she — and my other two daughters they help me out and my son, he shows me how to use Finale and all of this kind of stuff. And my oldest boy, although he’s not doing it anymore, but he helped me on a lot of tunes you know. Yeah, they all help me. But my daughter Joya is the one that takes care of me all the time.
Yeah, and I can attest that she does a fine job helping set this interview up today.
